title: Llama wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='43' y='52' width='14' height='38' rx='6' fill='#f2e2c4'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#f7ecd6'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='22' ry='9' fill='#e6d3b0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='19' rx='6' ry='11' fill='#f2e2c4' transform='rotate(-18 35 19)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='19' rx='6' ry='11' fill='#f2e2c4' transform='rotate(18 65 19)'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='20' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#e39a8c' transform='rotate(-18 35 19)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='20' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#e39a8c' transform='rotate(18 65 19)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#f7ecd6'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f0dcba'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#c98b7a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 49 Q50 53 55 49' stroke='#b57460' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='31' y='29' width='16' height='11' rx='4' fill='#3a2f5e'/>
  <rect x='53' y='29' width='16' height='11' rx='4' fill='#3a2f5e'/>
  <rect x='46' y='32' width='8' height='3' fill='#3a2f5e'/>
  <rect x='34' y='31' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8fd0ff'/>
  <rect x='56' y='31' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8fd0ff'/>
  <!-- arm -->
  <rect x='55' y='31' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#3a2f5e'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='90' width='7' height='8' rx='3' fill='#e6d3b0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='90' width='7' height='8' rx='3' fill='#e6d3b0'/>
  <!-- fluff on head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='22' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='22' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
